patches.description: Always show all 4 event-theming icons (Black Friday, Summer Sales, Autumn Sales, El Buen Fin) in the icon picker, regardless of whether the corresponding event is currently active. Vanilla shows only the icon for the active event (if any) and hides the other 3.
patches.name: Always show event-theming icons

patches.description: Replaces every state-mutating public static method on `com.adjust.sdk.Adjust` (initSdk, onResume, onPause, trackEvent, trackAdRevenue, verifyAndTrackPlayStorePurchase, enable, disable, addGlobalCallbackParameter, addGlobalPartnerParameter) with return-void, so Pepper's manual `Adjust.initSdk(...)` call from PepperApplication and any subsequent event tracking become no-ops. Companion to NeuterTrackerProviders for the Adjust stack: provider auto-init was already cut, this kills the manual-init path too. URLs are still redirected by patch 01 as a safety net; this patch is purely about not burning the Adjust threadpool for no reason.
patches.name: Disable Adjust SDK

dependencies: Disable Google Mobile Ads SDK init
patches.description: Replaces every public `load` / `loadAd` / `loadAds` method on AdLoader, AdManagerAdView, AdManagerInterstitialAd, RewardedAd and RewardedInterstitialAd with `return-void`. Companion to NopGmaInit: blocks the runtime path Pepper's `kfb` adapter uses to fetch native ads from googleads.g.doubleclick.net / pubads.g.doubleclick.net / *.googlesyndication.com / *.2mdn.net (98 leaks observed in 10 min on emulator-5558 with patches 01–05).
patches.name: Disable Google Mobile Ads ad-load entry points

patches.description: Replaces `com.google.android.gms.ads.MobileAds.initialize` (both overloads) with an empty body so the GMA SDK is never bootstrapped. Companion to NeuterTrackerProviders for the GMA stack: MobileAdsInitProvider was already a no-op in stock 8.13.00, but Pepper's own nh4.smali calls MobileAds.initialize() directly during ad-render path setup — without this patch, the GMA SDK still spins up and pre-fetches script/HTML/appcache resources from googleads.g.doubleclick.net plus gampad/ads ad requests to pubads.g.doubleclick.net.
patches.name: Disable Google Mobile Ads SDK init

patches.description: Removes Google Play's PAIRIP install-source enforcement from `com.pepperdeals` (and any other pepper-family build that ships it) by replacing `LicenseContentProvider.onCreate` with `return false` and `LicenseClient.initializeLicenseCheck` with `return-void`. Without this patch, sideloaded / ReVanced-patched Pepper.com APKs show a 'Something went wrong — Check that Google Play is enabled' dialog and can't be opened. PAIRIP is only present in the global/US build; the other nine regional sister apps don't bundle it and this patch is a no-op on them.
patches.name: Disable PAIRIP license check

patches.description: Re-enables the hidden 3-dot debug menu in MainActivity (45 debug actions: ad inspector, exploration screens, navigation, consent reset, event theming, monetization, etc.).
patches.name: Enable debug menu

options.description: Resource ID of R.menu.activity_main_debug. Default 0x7f0f0006 works for v8.12.00; if it shifts, look up the new ID in the APK's res/values/public.xml under name="activity_main_debug".
options.name: debugMenuResId

patches.description: Companion fix for the ad-hiding patch. After ad cells collapse to zero height, the deal-detail RecyclerView's ItemDecoration still allocates a 16dp section gap under each (invisible) ad and paints a shadow_divider on top of the next section's header. This patch inserts guards so collapsed ad cells contribute no offset and no draw, restoring the natural single-padding look.
patches.name: Fix spacing around hidden ad cells

options.description: Resource ID of `adapter_delegate_view_type_small_ad`. Default is correct for Pepper PL v8.12.00; look up the package's value in res/values/public.xml if a future build shifts ID slots.
options.name: smallAdViewTypeId

patches.description: Disables the banner-ad renderer (Pubmatic OpenWrap / DFPBanner) in the deal feed. Banner ads never load and the empty gray ad-cell container is collapsed to zero height. Lists look as if ad slots were never inserted.
patches.name: Hide banner ads in feed

patches.description: Disables the use-case that auto-restores the default icon on app start when an event (Black Friday / Summer Sales / etc.) has ended by date. With this patch your chosen event icon stays as the launcher permanently — no "Our event mode is over!" dialog on next launch.
patches.name: Keep event icon after restart

patches.description: NOPs the JobScheduler entry point of Google's Datatransport library so Crashlytics report uploads (crashlyticsreports-pa.googleapis.com/v1/firelog/legacy/batchlog) and Firebase logging uploads (firebaselogging-pa.googleapis.com) never POST. Pepper doesn't use Firebase Sessions so disabling Datatransport's upload leaves the rest of Firebase init untouched.
patches.name: Kill Datatransport upload pipeline

patches.description: NOPs Pepper's AnalyticsEventTransmissionWorker so server-pushed pixel-tracking URLs (Pepper Ocular batch_receiver_app + per-event tracking pixels) are stored in Room DB but never POSTed. Also replaces Pepper's real hardware ID with a fixed per-build mock ID in both POST /device registration and the Pepper-Hardware-Id request header, keeping Daily Picks usable without exposing the real ID.
patches.name: Kill Pepper first-party pixel tracking

patches.description: Replaces onCreate() in Vungle, Adjust SystemLifecycle, and Facebook Audience Network ContentProvider classes with `return false`, so each provider reports failed init to Android and its SDK auto-initialisation code never runs. Bytecode equivalent of removing the <provider> entries from AndroidManifest.xml — necessary because ReVanced 22.0.1-SNAPSHOT resourcePatches break Pepper boot on this version (a no-op resourcePatch reproduces the hang).
patches.name: Neuter tracker auto-init ContentProviders

patches.description: Rewrites every tracker URL string constant in the dex to https://127.0.0.1:1 (unreachable) so SDK HTTP clients cannot reach the real backend. Covers Pepper Ocular, Recombee, Iterable, Usercentrics 1px+UCT, Adjust, Vungle, Pubmatic, Firebase Analytics, Firebase Remote Config, Crashlytics settings, LiveRamp, Confiant, Moloco, Facebook Audience Network adnw_logging, Google Mobile Ads (pagead/googleads/imasdk/csi/pubads/mediation.goog/admob-gmats/obplaceholder), AdMob CMP funding-choices, and Pepper dev endpoint.
patches.name: Redirect tracker URLs to localhost

patches.description: Makes all 12 membership-tier icons (Silver/Gold/Platinum + DealMinded/DealDetective/Chilling/Awesome/Tight/Cool/Mascots) available in the icon picker without having to farm loyalty points.
patches.name: Unlock tier-locked icons
